body:
The sole original guarded FP32 restoring benefit trial is complete: **REJECT_GUARDED_FP32_RESTORING_COST**. It passed **1/4 whole-call, 9/16 stage and 1/2 inclusive API gates (11/22)**; all 22 are required. The candidate remains private and is not adopted. No unchanged retry, pooled comparison, cost subtraction or resampling is authorized by this result.

The complete trial is preserved and pushed in [`cc5b1e9f`](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/cc5b1e9f69ca34ba19e5bd5439b3e3b51ccfa53f/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-restoring-original-benefit), tag `evidence/issue-44-fp32-estimate-restoring-original-benefit`. Manifest SHA256: `163f45929dbd67c76527f5a903b45b704218030db2d305aff51fbd0560f8feb9` (122 files). Accepted primitive/profile and eight-control prerequisites remain separate; the latter are preserved in `9979d990`.

The unchanged original A1/B1/B2/A2 order used three repeats per family/slot, forced LVP/device0/cacheOFF, original measured windows and 300-second/4-GiB RSS/2-GiB reserve limits. All five operator commands ran once and closed with exit 0. Both actual executable bytes and all 23 resources were reused from the accepted controls, with no new compiler/link/provider-query phase.

Whole-call median improvements, each requiring >=5%:

| Direction | Family | Improvement | Gate |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| Forward | Legacy | -130.26% | Fail |
| Forward | Modern | -2.33% | Fail |
| Reverse | Legacy | +61.49% | Pass |
| Reverse | Modern | -8.35% | Fail |

Provisioning-inclusive Create plus all 11 original numerical API windows require >=0% in each direction: forward **-45.60%** (fail), reverse **+47.55%** (pass). All samples remain in the archive. These directional differences do not identify a driver, scheduling, branch-frequency or native-code cause.

Correctness and ownership checks completed: four original XML reports with zero failures/errors/skips/disabled; 4,968 actual input rows/1,243 unique current files; 10,249 owner samples; 114 protected payloads unchanged; four fresh observed births absent. Each slot retained all 32 complete readbacks, 51 ordered markers and 54 module/command joins across four timed roles and seven selected modules. Independent raw-XML recomputation agrees with every original comparator gate. Current slot mappings prove LVP birth/session/device/inode only; current loader/LLVM byte pins and earlier three-provider control evidence remain separate.

The whole owned temporary inventories were verified against local and Git archive bytes before retirement. A bounded follow-up source review found no justified distinct optimization in the inspected lowering: product-duplication removal already has a rejected multiply64 trial, and five-to-four correction-bit tuning would be speculative. This result leaves retained latency and the original cold-frame deadline unresolved. It establishes no hit rate, hardware-domain, full-science, frame, production or release qualification. Canonical source remains clean, committed and pushed at `4498cc41` on `development/minimum-step-floor-2026-10-15`, with one worktree.
scope: Operational issue receipt only; fixed cost rejection/no qualification.
